lines.en: One step, half a step, one more.
My bones are light; my walk drifts.
My sword drags, scoring the ground.

lines.zh: 铠甲破了个洞，风灌进来。
lines.en: A hole in my armor lets the wind in.
I know this road; I just cannot hurry.
The lich walks ahead; I follow.
My leg bones grind, creak and creak.
Do not rush me; I cannot go faster.
Soft dirt is easier on the walk.
I walked like this when I was alive.
The rusty sword is heavier than I am.
Slow, yes, but I have not stopped.
I stand and wait for the lich to speak.
I cannot grip the sword; it keeps sliding down.
There is nothing inside this armor.

lines.zh: 我试着想起自己的名字。
lines.en: I try to recall my own name.

lines.zh: 坟土的味道，还在鼻骨里。
lines.en: The smell of grave soil stays in my nose bone.
A joint creaks once, then quiet.
Standing here lasts a long while.
I remember being a soldier.
Wind slips between my ribs and out.
Waiting for orders, waiting for the next fight.
You are more neatly dressed than I am.
Living eyes are so bright.
Was I this tall when alive?
Your sword is newer than mine.
I am looking at what hangs at your waist.
Hold still; let me recognize that face.
You look like the new recruit in camp.
The lich says watching you is watching an enemy.

lines.zh: 你胸腔里的动静，我听得见。
lines.en: I can hear the stir inside your chest.
I want to salute, but my hand will not obey.
One bone broke; I can still walk.
The armor took most of it for me.
I am not in pain; I just cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 这一击，让我歪了半边身。
lines.en: That hit left me leaning to one side.
You struck an old wound.
I step back half a pace, bones rattling.
No flesh or blood; hard to break.
This blow reminds me of the battlefield.
I am still standing. Do not hurry.
The lich will put me back together.

lines.zh: 吃的？我连下巴都快掉了。
lines.en: Food? My jaw is nearly falling off.
That smell, I cannot place it.
The lich gives me no meals.

lines.zh: 面包递过来，我只能看着。
lines.en: Bread is held out, and I can only look.
I have no stomach to hold it.
When alive, this was my favorite.
You eat; I will just smell it.
My hand cannot hold it; do not waste it.
Bones need soil, not grain.
Hungry so long, yet I cannot die of it.
You knocked the sword from my grip.
Make way; I walk slowly.
The armor rang; it is not my pain.
One push and I will topple over.
Your shoulder is harder than mine.
One bump and I lean half a step.
I am in the way; I will shift.
The lich is behind; do not crowd.
Bone on bone is brittle work.
Steady me; I am about to fall.

lines.zh: 这副骨架，什么都做不了。
lines.en: This frame can do nothing of the sort.
I have no companion, only a master.
I cannot recall my living days clearly.

lines.zh: 尸奴是从土里叫出来的。
lines.en: Thralls are called up from the soil.
No wedding, and no home.
Ask the lich about that.
My bones are kept for no one.
Dead, we do not speak of such things.
Many comrades, no friends.
Who would want this broken armor?
The sword fell; I must pick it up.
This shard can go into a wall.
My hands let things slip through.
Gold? It is no use to me.
Do not hand it to me; I cannot hold it steady.
Pick it up and give it to the lich.
This thing looks like mine from life.
I am missing a finger; I cannot pinch it.
Shards belong to the Dread Lair, whoever finds them.
I bend slowly; wait for me.
The lich points; I turn slowly.
You are standing in front of the lich.
I raise my sword, and my hand shakes.
The command is louder than my fear.
The enemy is there; I have marked it.
I am slow; do not run too far.
This body still knows how to charge.
You smell like the living.

lines.zh: 剑尖对着你，我尽量拿稳。
lines.en: The point is on you; I hold it as steady as I can.
The lich wants you dead, so I come.

lines.zh: 我不是对手，但我是第一个。
lines.en: I am no match, but I am the first.
Do not mock my pace; I always arrive.
My bones rattle. Is that a war drum?
I have caught up. Do not look back.

lines.zh: 尸巫抬手，我就知道该动了。
lines.en: The wight raises a hand; I know to move.

lines.zh: 你在前头走，我在后头跟。
lines.en: You walk ahead, and I trail behind.
You ran far; I am still walking.
Print to print, I will not lose you.
The sword drags loudly on the ground.
Circling will not help; I know the way.
I remember which way you went.
That shadow ahead, it is you, yes?
Pause a moment and let me catch up.
My leg bones wear hot, and still I walk.
This door, I can push open.
You hid in the grass, and the grass moves.
I can smell the heat of the living.
Run more and I will call the lich.
Slow as I am, my direction is right.

lines.zh: 我沿着地下的走廊追你。
lines.en: I follow you down the underground hall.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在拐角撞了一下。
lines.en: My bones knock against the corner.
Do not take the stairs; I climb slowly.
I switch the sword to my other hand.
The rusty sword comes down and loses a notch.
I strike with the flat to spare the edge.
This blow, I practiced while alive.
My hand rises slowly and falls slowly.
My armor slams in and you give ground.
The blade is dull; the blow still hurts.
I have hold of you. Do not struggle.
I use my bones as a hammer.
Do not dodge; I aimed for a long time.
The lich taught me this strike.
I am not strong, but I do not fear pain.

lines.zh: 倒下前，我还能再砍一下。
lines.en: Before I fall, I can swing once more.
The sword is stuck; let me pull it free.

lines.zh: 你退后，我要再抬一次手。
lines.en: Step back; I will raise my arm again.

lines.zh: 剑落下，砸在你的肩甲上。
lines.en: The sword falls on your shoulder plate.
I reach out and grab your collar.
The soil turned over and I climbed out.

lines.zh: 尸巫招了招手，土就开了。
lines.en: The lich beckoned, and the soil opened.

lines.zh: 这身铠甲，跟我一起埋的。
lines.en: This armor was buried with me.
The sword is still here, badly rusted.
I sat up out of the grave.
Soil above me, then wind.

lines.zh: 是尸巫把我从土里喊起来的。
lines.en: The lich called me up from the dirt.
With the bones set, I can stand.
It was crowded below; I came out.
This patch of soil, I slept in it.
The soil in my armor will not shake out.
I stand, and my knees creak first.
My master's command is heavier than grave soil.
I am here, a little slower.
Fire heats the old armor and burns my bones.
I fell, and half my bones came apart.
Water fills my armor and I sink.
The blast took my helmet; I grope for it.

lines.zh: 箭穿过肋骨，卡在甲缝里。
lines.en: An arrow passed my ribs and stuck in the armor seam.
Spellfire on bone leaves it numb.

lines.zh: 我连饥饿是什么都忘了。
lines.en: I have forgotten what hunger even is.
Lightning struck and bleached my bones.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我落不下去。
lines.en: No soil in the void; I cannot settle.
